Cavities: removed material in var(--ground) with a var(--muted) outline; a 2–4 px stroke of var(--ok) along the sidewalls whose thickness follows the Passivation slider, labelled 'sidewall passivation (polymer)'; the floor drawn as a heavier var(--accent) line labelled 'etch front'. Correct shapes: isotropic = circular arcs of radius ≈ depth under each mask edge; footing = fillet narrowing the base; notch = small rounded gouge at the floor corner; bowing = mid-wall bulge; Bosch = N semicircular scallops with a vertical mean wall.

5. In-place numbers: a depth dimension line on the right of each trench ('depth 118 nm' / 'depth 42 nm'), and between them a bracket 'ARDE: narrow lags by 76 nm'. Leader-line callouts 'undercut', 'bowing', 'footing', 'notch', 'scallops', 'etch stop' appear only when that term is active, positioned at the feature.

6. Presets must produce the aspect ratios and rates their notes quote: give each preset its own opening width, film thickness, vertical scale (with a scale bar such as '1 µm' for Bosch/NAND) and mask selectivity; show the preset's note text under the controls when a preset is active. Ion energy range 20 eV–5 keV; rate 0 when ions and radicals are both 0; Wet HF shows 'no ions'.

7. Responsiveness: keep SVG label font-size ≥ 11 px at 360 px width by scaling font-size with (viewBoxWidth / clientWidth) from a ResizeObserver, or move the trench labels into HTML under the drawing; move the 'horizontal scale exaggerated' caption out of the mask band. Return a cleanup that disconnects the observer.

defects.where: site/widgets/implant-profile.js render(): yMin/yMax derivation (lines ~132-134) — shot 760-dark/light-B-energy-max-500keV-dose-min-1e11-bg-max-1e18.png
defects.what: When the as-implanted peak is below 10^yMin (yMin is derived only from the background, e.g. Nb=1e18 -> yMin=17, but peak0=2.2e15) the y range inverts (yMax 16.4 < yMin 17): no gridlines, no y labels, both curves collapse to a flat line on the floor, and the background line + its label are pushed ~400 units below the SVG (clipped). The chart becomes a 280 px blank rectangle. This is reachable with realistic low-dose settings (e.g. 1e11-1e12 cm^-2 at >=100 keV into a 1e17-1e18 substrate), not just at the slider corners.
defects.fix: Compute the y window from BOTH curves and the background: yMin = max(13, floor(min(log10 peak0, log10 Nb)) - 1), yMax = max(log10 peak0, log10 Nb) + 0.4, and enforce yMax - yMin >= 2. Clamp ybg into [PY0, PY1] and, when peak < Nb, still draw the curve and background line, with a caption 'peak below background: no junction'.

defects.where: Species control row at 360 px — shots implant-profile-360-dark.png / -light.png; harness report 'select exceeds box by 8px', 'output exceeds box by 80px'
defects.what: The Species <label class=w-ctl> holds an empty <output> (min-width 64 px) next to a <select> whose longest option ('74Ge+ germanium (PAI, not a dopant)') is ~250 px; the grid cannot shrink it, so the select pokes 8 px past the widget box and the empty output sits 80 px outside it. The page scrolls horizontally on a phone.
defects.fix: Remove the empty <output> from the Species label (or give it min-width:0 and no content), set the select to style {minWidth:0, width:'100%'}, and shorten the option labels ('11B+ boron', '49BF2+ (B at 11/49 E)', '74Ge+ (PAI, not a dopant)').

defects.where: SVG axis text at 360 px — shot implant-profile-360-dark.png (chart) and 2x zoom
defects.what: The 660-unit viewBox renders 286 px wide on a phone, so the 10 px axis labels ('10^19', '0', '100', 'background 7.9x10^15') become 4.3 px and the whole chart is 147 px tall — unreadable. At 760 px the same text is 10.4 px, still under the 11 px floor.
defects.fix: Use font-size 13-14 for axis text in the current viewBox (renders 13.5 px at 760) and, when el.clientWidth < 480, rebuild the SVG with a narrow viewBox (e.g. 360 x 300, PX0 = 44, 3-4 y ticks, 3 x ticks) via ResizeObserver so labels stay >= 11 px; or move the axis labels into HTML flex rows outside the SVG.

defects.where: SPECIES.B D0 = 0.037 (line 15) and the anneal broadening — shots anneal-max-1100C-3600s.png, P-30keV-1e15.png vs default
defects.what: 0.037 exp(-3.46 eV/kT) is only Plummer's neutral (D0) term for boron; the total intrinsic diffusivity is D0 + D+ ≈ 0.76·exp(-3.46/kT) (Fair). The module's key number is ~2e-14 cm²/s at 1000 °C; the widget gives 7.4e-16 (20x low). Consequences: 1100 °C/1 h shows ΔRp' = 75 nm where the model should give ~330 nm; the default 1050 °C/594 s shows 32 nm instead of ~82 nm; and phosphorus appears to diffuse 5x faster than boron at the same recipe (74 vs 32 nm), the reverse of reality. Sb (0.02/3.5) and Ge (0.03/3.5) are also invented values.
defects.fix: Use the Fair/Plummer intrinsic totals: B D0 = 0.76, Ea = 3.46; P 3.85/3.66; As 0.066/3.44 (optionally + 12·exp(-4.05/kT)); Sb 0.214/3.65; Ge ~ use Si self-diffusion-scale 0.3/3.5 and say 'approx.'. Re-check: B at 1000 °C must print ~1.5-2e-14 cm²/s; show D in the readout so the learner can compare with the module's key number.

defects.where: 'background …' SVG label (line 149) — visible in default, worked-example, energy-min, BF2, P, As, Sb shots (2x zoom confirms)
defects.what: The label is anchored at the right end of the dashed background line, exactly where the after-anneal curve crosses it in most states, so the orange curve runs through the word 'background'. Text overlapping a shape.
defects.fix: Anchor the label at the left end of the dashed line (x = PX0 + 6, text-anchor start, 4 px above the line) where no curve is (concentration there is far above background), or pick whichever side of the deepest junction crossing has >= 140 units free; add paint-order:stroke with a var(--panel) halo.

defects.where: Chart annotations (render(), lines 137-164) — every shot
defects.what: The drawing has no in-place labels: the two peak dots and the two dots on the background line are unlabeled, there is no 'Rp', 'ΔRp', 'xj' or 'surface' marker, and the y axis has no title or unit (cm⁻³). A non-expert cannot connect the eight readouts to the picture; the standard forbids legend-only labelling and axes without units.
defects.fix: See redesign: label Rp with a drop line to the axis ('Rp = 74 nm'), draw a ΔRp bracket at Rp±ΔRp, label each junction dot ('xj 177 nm' / 'xj 193 nm'), write 'surface' at x = 0, add a rotated y-axis title 'concentration (cm⁻³)', and superscript the powers of ten.

defects.where: peak0 / Rs readouts — shot B-energy-min-0p5keV-dose-max-1e16.png (1.3×10^22 cm⁻³, 16 Ω/sq); worked example 2.4×10^20
defects.what: Solid solubility is ignored: 0.5 keV B at 1e16 reports a peak of 1.3e22 cm⁻³ (a quarter of all lattice sites) and a sheet resistance of 16 Ω/sq at 'full activation' with no warning, and the worked-example peak of 2.4e20 (which the module singles out as 'right at boron's solubility limit') is shown without comment. Rs keeps falling with dose long after the dopant could be active.
defects.fix: Add a per-species dashed 'solid solubility' line on the chart (B ~2e20, P ~1e21, As ~2e21, Sb ~5e19 cm⁻³ at ~1000 °C) and a warning chip in the readout when the peak exceeds it; compute Rs from the active dose ∫min(N(x), N_sol)dx rather than the full dose, and label it 'Rs (solubility-capped activation)'.

defects.where: Defaults st = {eFrac:55, dFrac:55, bFrac:30, T:1050, tFrac:78} and logSlider mapping (lines 49, 93-96) — default shots and worked-example shot (9.75 keV)
defects.what: The first frame is an arbitrary 22 keV / 5.6e13 / 7.9e15 state with a 1050 °C 10-minute 'anneal' that is neither an RTA (1-30 s) nor a furnace (800-1000 °C) recipe, instead of the module's worked example. The 0-100 integer sliders on log scales cannot reach round values: 10 keV lands on 9.75 keV, so the learner cannot reproduce the module's 37/17 nm, 93 nm numbers.
defects.fix: Start on the module's example: 11B+, 10 keV, 1e15 cm⁻², N_B = 1e18, spike anneal 1050 °C 1 s. Make the energy and dose sliders step in 0.1 decade and round the displayed/used value to 2 significant figures (or a 1-2-5 series), and add three anneal preset buttons (spike 1050 °C 1 s, RTA 1000 °C 10 s, furnace 900 °C 30 min).

defects.where: note (line 166) — only static text under the chart
defects.what: There is no per-state explanation (criterion 7): the only prose is a fixed four-sentence caveat paragraph. Nothing tells the learner what the current picture means ('the peak is above the 1e18 well so a junction forms at 88 nm; the anneal pushes it to 109 nm').
defects.fix: Add a dynamic one-line explanation above the note that is rebuilt in render(): '<species> at <E> stops <Rp> nm deep (±<ΔRp>). The <peak> peak is above the <Nb> background, so a p-n junction forms at <xj0>; <T> °C for <t> s broadens ΔRp to <ΔRp'> and moves the junction to <xj1>.' with a variant for no-junction and for Ge.

defects.where: x-axis tick loop (line 143) and curve floor clamp (line 155) — worked-example, anneal-min, As shots show only '0' and '100'
defects.what: Ticks step by 10^floor(log10 xMax), so any range just above a decade gets two labels (0 and 100 for xMax = 133) while 950 nm gets ten; there is no axis line and no tick marks, and beyond the plot floor the polylines run flat along 10^yMin, which reads as a real 1e17 plateau.
defects.fix: Pick the tick step from the 1-2-5 series so there are 4-8 ticks, draw x/y axis lines with 4-unit tick marks, and stop the polyline (break into segments) where N < 10^yMin instead of clamping.

defects.where: sci() used for readouts, slider outputs and axis labels (lines 41, 98-99, 116, 119, 141, 149)
defects.what: Powers of ten are printed with a caret ('8.1×10^18 cm⁻³', '10^19') next to properly superscripted 'cm⁻³'; sciHtml() is defined but never used.
defects.fix: Render superscripts: use Unicode superscript digits for SVG/output text (10¹⁹) or <sup> via sciHtml() in the HTML readouts.

defects.where: stXj0/stXj1 formatting fmt(xj, 1) (lines 117, 120) — shot B-energy-max-500keV-dose-min-1e11-bg-min-1e15.png
defects.what: '1 656.6 nm' shows 0.1 nm precision on a 1.7 µm number derived from an 8-point interpolation.
defects.fix: Use 1 decimal below 100 nm, 0 decimals to 1000 nm, and µm with 2 decimals above.

defects.where: annealCtl.style.opacity = .45 for Ge (line 122) — shot 760-light-Ge-20keV-1e15-PAI.png
defects.what: Dimming the anneal sliders to 45 % makes 'Anneal temperature 1050 °C' nearly invisible in the light theme while the controls still work and still change ΔRp'.
defects.fix: Do not dim; keep the controls fully legible and add the Ge sentence ('no junction: Ge is isoelectronic; the anneal regrows the amorphous layer') to the dynamic explanation instead.

defects.where: curve draw order (lines 159-160) — anneal-min-900C-1s and As spike shots
defects.what: When the anneal is negligible the after-anneal curve is drawn exactly over the as-implanted one, so the purple curve listed in the legend is invisible.
defects.fix: Draw the as-implanted curve last (on top) or make the after-anneal curve dashed/thicker so both remain visible when they coincide.

defects.where: 'none (peak < background)' readout string (lines 117, 120) — degenerate shots
defects.what: An 18 px bold 25-character value breaks the 4-up readout row into a ragged 3+1 layout.
defects.fix: Show 'none' as the value and put 'peak below background' in the muted sub-label.

defects.where: el.append order (lines 173-175) and CH = 340 with PY1 = 270
defects.what: The chart is the seventh element, below two control rows and eight stats; on a phone it is 1000 px down. The SVG also carries ~38 empty units under the x-axis title.
defects.fix: Order: primary controls, chart, readouts, anneal controls, anneal readouts; set CH ≈ 310 so the title sits 10 units above the bottom edge.

defects.where: Chart interaction — hover-peak-dot shots identical to default
defects.what: No hover state or readout anywhere on the chart; the peak/junction dots look interactive but do nothing.
defects.fix: Optional: add a crosshair on pointermove showing depth and both concentrations, with a visible highlight on the nearest dot.

defects.where: Ge/As/Sb high-dose states — Ge-20keV-1e15-PAI shot
defects.what: The module's point about PAI (Ge 20 keV at 1e15 amorphises ~30 nm ≈ Rp + 2ΔRp) is not shown; the plot also stops at Rp + 4ΔRp so the curve exits the right edge mid-slope.
defects.fix: When dose exceeds the amorphisation threshold (~2e14 for Ge/As/Sb) shade a band from the surface to Rp + 2ΔRp labelled 'amorphous layer', and extend xMax to where the curve reaches the floor.

result.redesign: The concentration-vs-depth chart is the right visual (it is what a SIMS profile looks like) but it must be annotated in place and tied to a wafer picture. Layout (viewBox 660 x 360): (1) a 34-unit-tall wafer cross-section strip across the top aligned to the depth axis: a thin 'surface' line at x = 0 with three short downward arrows labelled '¹¹B⁺ ions, 10 keV'; a shaded implanted band whose opacity follows N(x) (bright at Rp, fading by Rp ± 2ΔRp) labelled 'implanted layer'; a vertical junction line at xj labelled 'p-n junction'; the region beyond labelled with the background, e.g. 'n-well 10¹⁸ cm⁻³'. (2) Below it the log chart with drawn x and y axes, tick marks, 4-8 nice ticks, y-axis title 'concentration (cm⁻³)' rotated at the left, x-axis title 'depth below surface (nm)'. In-place labels: a drop line from the as-implanted peak to the axis labelled 'Rp = 32 nm'; a horizontal bracket from Rp - ΔRp to Rp + ΔRp at the peak/e^0.5 level labelled 'ΔRp = 17 nm'; each junction dot labelled 'xj 88 nm' (as implanted) and 'xj 109 nm' (after anneal) placed on alternate sides so they never collide; the background line labelled at its left end 'background 10¹⁸'; a dashed 'solid solubility 2×10²⁰' line with the label at its left end; 'surface' at x = 0. Curves: as-implanted solid accent2 on top, after-anneal accent (dashed when identical), both clipped where N < floor. All SVG text >= 13 units (>= 11 px at 760); at container width < 480 rebuild with a 360-wide viewBox, 3 ticks per axis and the wafer strip labels shortened. Numbers must animate nothing; they change with the sliders. Under the chart a one-sentence dynamic explanation reading the current numbers, then the static caveat note.

defects.where: site/widgets/euv-source.js lines 18-33, 76-95 (collector arcs, nozzle, laser beam, packet PATH)
defects.what: The source schematic is physically wrong and misleading: the collector is drawn as a ~285° ring centred on the plasma (plasma at the ring's centre, not at the near focus of an open ellipsoidal bowl); the droplet starts above the ring and visibly falls THROUGH the solid mirror arc (droplet-falling shot); the CO2 beam enters from the bottom, perpendicular to the collector axis, instead of through the central hole on the axis behind the plasma; no EUV rays are drawn from plasma to mirror to IF, and the animated packet flies in a straight line from the plasma to the IF through the ring's gap, so the collector is never shown collecting anything.
defects.fix: Redraw the source vessel as described in the redesign: open bowl facing the IF, plasma at its near focus, laser along the axis through the bowl's centre hole, droplet train falling vertically through the open mouth, and a visible cone of violet rays plasma -> bowl -> IF.

defects.where: euv-source-360-dark.png / euv-source-360-light.png (single SVG, viewBox 660 wide, font-size 10.5-11)
defects.what: At 360 px the whole diagram scales to 0.49x, so every SVG label (captions, M1-M6, IF, H2, CRA) renders at about 5 px and is illegible; the drawing is a 324x226 px thumbnail. The harness misses this because it reads the font-size attribute, not the rendered size.
defects.fix: Split the drawing into two SVGs (source vessel; scanner optics) each with a ~360-wide viewBox inside a .w-grid2 so each renders at ~0.9-1.0x on both phone and desktop, or set SVG text font-size = 12 / scale from a ResizeObserver so on-screen text is always >= 11 px, and hide tertiary captions below ~500 px.

defects.where: lines 5-6, 185, 191, 196-212, 221, 231-240 (REFL/N_REFL, slider label, chart stages, formula)
defects.what: Photon-budget model contradicts the module and the widget itself. The slider 'In-band source power' (250-600 W) is, per module 08 and per the widget's own IF hotspot ('IF ... where ASML specifies source power, 250-600 W'), the power AT the IF, yet the chart puts it at 'source' and multiplies by 0.67 at the collector, so the IF point reads 335 W. Wafer power = P0 x 0.67^10 = 9.1 W (1.8%) vs the module's ~1.2% of IF after 11 reflections (~6 W; ~5 W with pellicle/H2). The wafer hotspot says '~1-2% of IF power' while the chart implies 9.1/335 = 2.7%. The formula counts 'collector, 2 facets, reticle, M1-M6' whereas the module counts 4 illuminator reflections + reticle (0.65) + 6 POB after the IF.
defects.fix: Rename the slider 'Source power at IF'; start the chart at IF; stages = field facet, pupil facet, fold 1, fold 2 (x0.67 each), reticle (x0.65), M1-M6 (x0.67) -> P_wafer = P_IF x 0.67^10 x 0.65 ~ 1.2% (5.9 W at 500 W); update the formula box and the note accordingly; optionally add 'exposure time per wafer at 30 mJ/cm2 = 21 J / P_wafer'.

defects.where: lines 189-192 (.w-controls layout) - z-controls zoom of euv-source-760-dark.png
defects.what: At 760 px the 'In-band source power' range input's track is collapsed to ~0 px (only the thumb is visible), because the long label plus the buttons div squeeze the .w-ctl 1fr column; the slider is effectively unusable on desktop.
defects.fix: Put the Play/Pause + Slow-motion buttons on their own full-width row (style flexBasis:'100%') and shorten the label to 'Power at IF', or give the input style minWidth:'120px'.

defects.where: lines 27-31 vs 22 (PROJ[0] at ~(426,637) vs F2 at (410,640)); label at line 110
defects.what: Projection mirror M1 is drawn on top of the pupil-facet mirror (the two bars cross), and the 'pupil facet' caption sits under M1 with the M1->M2 dotted beam running through the text; the reticle's reflected ray appears to go back into the illuminator.
defects.fix: Move the projection optics to the right of the reticle so M1 sits >= 60 viewBox units from the pupil facet, and keep every mirror label on the side away from the incoming beam.

defects.where: lines 117-118 ('6 deg CRA' text), 89 ('CO2 laser in'), 136 ('Wafer stage (scans)'), 127 (M labels), 210-212 (chart x labels), 208/239 (chart wafer label)
defects.what: Text collisions: the '6 deg CRA (angle exaggerated)' label is crossed by both reticle rays; the collector arc passes through the word 'laser' in 'CO2 laser in'; the chart's 'source' and 'IF' x-labels overlap into 'sourIFe' (flagged by the harness in all four renders); 'Wafer stage (scans)' and the M2/M4/M6 labels lie on the beam path so the animated packet passes through them (slow-motion-on and euv-packet-projection shots); the '9.1 W' / '10.9 W' chart label crosses the polyline.
defects.fix: Move the CRA label beside the arc, not below the reticle bounce point; move the laser caption clear of the arc; drop the 'source' label (chart starts at IF) and give every stage an abbreviated tick label; move the stage caption to the bottom of the stage box and the M labels off the beam; anchor the wafer label above-right of the last point with a background rect.

defects.where: first frame (euv-source-760-dark.png and the no-reduced-motion capture); drawing layout lines 70-141
defects.what: First frame is not meaningful: for a normal user t=0 shows only an orange dot inside a grey ring; no plasma, no EUV light, all light paths are faint grey dotted lines; the upper-left ~40% of the canvas is empty apart from two floating captions ('Illuminator', 'field facet'); every mirror is a 30-px tick mark smaller than its label, so the picture reads as a constellation, not a machine.
defects.fix: Start the animation mid-cycle (phase ~0.66, plasma flash + packet in flight) and draw a persistent plasma glow and a permanent EUV ray cone; fill the canvas with the two-panel layout in the redesign.

defects.where: lines 62 (caption), 245-281 (frame), no status element
defects.what: The animation phases are not narrated: nothing on screen says 'droplet falls / pre-pulse flattens it / main pulse makes plasma / EUV collected to IF'. The caption promises 'watch the photon budget shrink at every reflection' but nothing in the drawing or chart changes as the packet bounces (packet radius/opacity constant, chart static).
defects.fix: Add a one-line phase status under the drawing that highlights the active phase with a 1-sentence explanation, and shrink the packet radius/opacity by 0.67 at each mirror (and light up the corresponding chart dot) so the budget is visibly consumed.

defects.where: lines 87 (laserBeam opacity .3), 103/122 (dashed --line2 1.5 px) - euv-source-760-light.png
defects.what: In the light theme the dashed beam path (--line2 #C3CBD6 on the light ground) and the CO2 beam at 0.3 opacity are nearly invisible, so the light path cannot be followed.
defects.fix: Draw the EUV path as a solid --accent2 line (opacity >= .6) and the laser as --warn at opacity >= .7 in both themes; use --muted rather than --line2 for construction lines.

defects.where: lines 195-212 (photon budget chart)
defects.what: Chart axis labels are 10 px (below the 11 px rule); only three x labels for eleven stages; no axis titles or units on the x axis; the lower third of the chart (below 10 W) is empty.
defects.fix: Font-size >= 11; tick label every stage (abbreviated: FF, PF, fold, fold, ret, M1..M6); y title 'in-band power, W (log)'; set logMin so the wafer point sits ~20% above the axis.

defects.where: lines 176-179 (info panel minHeight 54 px)
defects.what: Hovering a part with a 3-line description grows the info panel by ~20 px, shifting the readouts, chart and note down on every hover (hover-collector vs base shot).
defects.fix: Set minHeight to ~78 px (or fix two lines with text clamping) so the panel never resizes.

defects.where: lines 81-85 (H2 arrows, marker-end 'none'), 134-135 (wafer stage arrows)
defects.what: The two H2 'arrows' are bare green ticks with no arrowheads and read as stray marks; the wafer stage shows two arrows pointing inward at the wafer, which does not depict scanning.
defects.fix: Use a defs marker arrowhead on the H2 flow lines pointing along the collector face toward the pump; draw one horizontal double-headed 'scan' arrow under the wafer and a counter-arrow '4x' at the reticle.

defects.where: COMPONENTS lines 49-55
defects.what: Key-number mismatches with module 08: laser '~20-30 kW' (module: ~25-40 kW); reticle 'x0.67 reflectance' (module: ~0.65 for a patterned mask); 'unresolved transition array' is used without definition; the reticle hotspot rectangle overlaps the 'Reflective reticle' caption when highlighted.
defects.fix: Use 25-40 kW and 0.65; add '(UTA: many overlapping ion lines that merge into one broad 13.5 nm band)'; start the reticle hotspot at y=548.

defects.where: line 183 (playBtn class 'w-btn')
defects.what: Play/Pause is not the primary button, so the animation control is not visually prominent.
defects.fix: Give it class 'w-btn primary'.

defects.where: lines 187-192, 227-228 (throughput slider)
defects.what: The throughput slider only changes 'droplets per wafer'; there is no link between wafer power, dose and exposure time, which is the module's key relation (21 J per wafer at 30 mJ/cm2 -> ~4 s at 5 W).
defects.fix: Add a readout 'pure exposure time per wafer = 707 cm2 x 30 mJ/cm2 / P_wafer' that responds to the power slider, and state '16 s per wafer at 220 wph is mostly stage overhead'.

result.redesign:
Replace the single 660x460 SVG with two side-by-side panels in a .w-grid2 (stack on phones), each an SVG with viewBox about 0 0 380 320 so it renders near 1x at both 360 px and 760 px; all labels font-size 12, drawn in place next to their parts.

PANEL A - 'Source vessel (LPP)': side view with the optical axis horizontal. Draw the vessel as a rounded rect with an aperture on its right wall. Inside, the COLLECTOR is a thick --si arc of about 200 degrees, opening to the RIGHT (an ellipsoidal bowl), with a small gap at the centre of its back (left) for the laser hole; label 'Collector: 650 mm Mo/Si ellipsoid, ~5 sr'. The PLASMA point sits on the axis inside the bowl about a quarter of the way from the bowl's back to its mouth (the near focus); draw a persistent soft glow (2-3 concentric --accent2 circles at decreasing opacity) labelled 'Sn plasma ~40 eV, 13.5 nm'. The CO2 LASER enters from the LEFT along the axis through the hole: dashed --warn line with an arrowhead, label 'CO2 laser 10.6 um, 25-40 kW'. The DROPLET GENERATOR is at the top of the vessel above the bowl mouth, nozzle pointing down; a train of 3-4 orange droplets falls vertically through the open mouth and crosses the axis exactly at the plasma point; a small 'tin catcher' cup at the bottom; label '27 um Sn droplets, 50 kHz, 70-80 m/s'. EUV RAYS: 6-8 solid --accent2 lines from the plasma point back to the bowl surface and reflected forward, converging on the IF marked as a small ring at the right wall aperture; label 'Intermediate focus (IF)' with the live value from the slider, e.g. '500 W in-band'. H2 flow: two or three --ok arrows with arrowheads sweeping along the collector face toward a 'to pumps' outlet; label 'H2 ~1 mbar: slows debris, Sn + 4H -> SnH4'. Animation A (3-4 s cycle): droplets advance; when one reaches the axis the laser dash flashes once (pre-pulse) and the droplet flattens into a wide ellipse; the laser flashes bright (main pulse); the plasma glow swells and the ray cone brightens; a packet leaves along the axis to the IF. A phase status line under panel A: '1 Droplet falls  2 Pre-pulse flattens it into a pancake  3 Main pulse: 30-40 eV plasma radiates 13.5 nm  4 Collector focuses it at the IF', highlighting the active phase with a one-sentence note.

PANEL B - 'Scanner (vacuum, few Pa H2)': IF ring at the left edge (the packet from panel A appears here). An 'Illuminator' box containing the field-facet and pupil-facet mirrors drawn as short segmented bars (5-6 tiles each) at 45 degrees plus one grazing fold mirror; the beam then rises to the RETICLE at the top: a horizontal bar with a light Mo/Si stripe and dark absorber ticks, labelled 'Reflective reticle (Mo/Si + Ta absorber), 6 deg chief-ray angle', with a small '4x' counter-scan arrow. From the reticle the beam drops into a 'Projection optics: 6 mirrors, 4x, NA 0.33' box on the right where M1-M6 are short concave arcs arranged in a zigzag whose path never crosses a label (labels on the outside of each bend). The beam ends at the WAFER: a flat --si disc on a stage block at the bottom with a horizontal double-headed 'scan' arrow, labelled 'Wafer on mag-lev stage'. Beam drawn as a solid --accent2 polyline whose stroke-width or opacity drops at every mirror; live power tags at IF, after the reticle and at the wafer (e.g. '500 W', '~110 W', '~6 W'). Animation B: the packet travels the path with radius shrinking by 0.67 at each bounce and a brief flash on arrival at the wafer; the corresponding chart dot lights up as the packet passes each mirror.

BELOW: controls row 1 = Play/Pause (primary) + Slow motion; row 2 = 'Source power at IF' 250-600 W and 'Throughput' 150-350 wph with full-width tracks. Photon-budget chart starting at IF with 11 labelled stages (FF, PF, fold, fold, reticle x0.65, M1-M6), y title 'in-band power, W (log)', fonts >= 11 px, wafer value label boxed. Readouts: droplets/s, droplets per wafer, tin per day, power at wafer (~1.2% of IF), and pure exposure time per wafer at 30 mJ/cm2. Formula box: P_wafer = P_IF x 0.67^10 x 0.65 ~ 1.2% x P_IF. Keep the hover/focus info panel but shape each hotspot to its part (arc-shaped for the collector) and fix its min height so the layout never jumps.

defects.where: site/widgets/node-table.js mount() assembly (lines 167-183); first frame node-table-760-dark.png / 360-dark.png
defects.what: There is no schematic. The widget never draws the thing its numbers describe (a standard cell: gates at CPP, metal tracks at MP, fins, cell height). The first frame is a 1,212 px tall, 11-column data table (box height 2,294 px at 760 px, 2,412 px at 360 px) that already needs horizontal scrolling at 760 px (table is 56 px wider than the box; the 'Wafer price' column is hidden), followed by an unlabeled dot chart and a numbers-only calculator. The one visual that carries the headline lesson ('nothing is 3 nm') is hidden behind an unchecked checkbox. A non-expert cannot look at this and understand what CPP, MP or 'tracks' physically are.
defects.fix: Lead with a to-scale NAND2 standard-cell drawing driven by the CPP/MP/tracks sliders (see redesign), show the true-scale ruler by default, and demote the full table to a collapsed 'Show full node table' section at the bottom with a sticky first column.

defects.where: drawChart(): fixed viewBox 680x340 with 11 px tick text (lines 60, 84, 90, 92-93); node-table-360-dark.png / 360-light.png
defects.what: At 360 px the chart SVG renders 286 px wide (scale 0.42), so 11 px tick labels render at ~4.6 px and 12 px axis titles at ~5 px; the whole plot is a 143 px tall illegible strip. The harness misses it because it checks computed font-size, not rendered size.
defects.fix: Size the viewBox from the container (ResizeObserver: viewBox width = el.clientWidth, height ~0.6x width, 1 unit = 1 px) so text stays 11-12 px at any width; reduce ticks to 3 and abbreviate axis titles when width < 480.

defects.where: setHover() -> drawChart() (lines 105-110) rebuilds the SVG with chart.innerHTML = '' on every hover; node-table-760-dark-after-mouse-leaves-point.png
defects.what: Hover state sticks and keyboard focus is lost. Because the hovered circle is destroyed and recreated, its mouseleave never fires: after the cursor moves to the legend, Intel 18A stays enlarged, its row stays highlighted and the detail text stays. A focused circle (tabindex=0) is destroyed on the focus event, so activeElement drops to BODY and Tab cannot step through points (probe confirmed). The same rebuild made puppeteer clicks on points throw 'Node is either not clickable'.
defects.fix: Create the circles once per axis change and keep them; on hover/focus only update attributes (r, stroke-width) on the existing elements and the detail text; add a mouseleave on the SVG and table to clear; call drawChart only on axis change and ctx.onTheme.

defects.where: renderScaleBox() bars (lines 121-136) vs ROWS N3E row (line 18) vs Module 11 Key Numbers ('Physical gate length 5/3/2 nm class: ~16-18 / ~15-16 / ~12-14 nm')
defects.what: The true-scale comparison contradicts the widget's own table and the module: it labels the bar '"3 nm" (the marketing name)' but uses gate length 13 nm (the 2 nm-class value); the table row for N3E says ~15 nm and Module 11 says N3 gate ~16 nm; the note below then talks about an 'N2-class "2 nm" chip'. Node and numbers are mixed.
defects.fix: Tie the ruler to one node consistently, e.g. N3E: '3 nm (name)' 3 nm, fin width ~6 nm, gate length ~16 nm, min metal pitch 23 nm, CPP 48 nm, cell height ~160 nm; or make the ruler follow the hovered/selected table row (r.glN, r.mpN, r.cppN). Show it by default.

defects.where: drawChart() ticks(n)/ytv (lines 80-91) and AXES.year.fmt (line 28)
defects.what: Ticks are raw fractions of the data range: years read '2014, 2017.1, 2020.3, 2023.4, 2026.5'; CPP '45 nm, 56 nm, 68 nm, 79 nm, 90 nm'; price '$5k, $12k, $19k, $26k, $33k'.
defects.fix: Add a nice-ticks helper (step = {1,2,2.5,5} x 10^n chosen for 4-6 ticks, extended to cover the padded range; integer years) and format years without decimals.

defects.where: drawChart() point rendering (lines 94-103); crop of chart in every 760 shot
defects.what: No point is labeled; Intel 10, TSMC N7 and Samsung 7LPP sit on top of each other at 2018, and the reader cannot tell which dot is N2 or 18A without hovering. The module's two lessons (CPP floor ~45 nm; density gain per node fell from 2x to 1.15x while wafer price rose 1.5x per node) are never annotated.
defects.fix: Label anchor nodes (N16, N7, N5, N3E, N2, 18A) with short text offset alternately above/below, label the hovered point in place; when CPP is on an axis draw a dashed '~45 nm floor: gate + 2 spacers + contact' line; when density vs year is shown draw the 2x and 1.15x per-node reference slopes; make density vs wafer price the default (it is the most instructive combination).

defects.where: setHover() detail sentence (line 108)
defects.what: The detail line concatenates raw table strings into nonsense: 'fin/sheet pitch sheet', '0.33 NA EUV; High-NA in dev. EUV layers', '0 (DUV only) EUV layers', 'min MP 30 (M0 28) nm', and 'wafer price ~$20-25k est..' (double period).
defects.fix: Compose from numeric fields with units and conditionals: fs === 'sheet' ? 'nanosheet (no fin pitch)' : `fin pitch ${fs} nm`; print the litho column as 'litho: ...'; strip trailing periods before appending the sentence's own.

defects.where: ROWS data (lines 9-24) vs Module 11 §2.2 and Module 21 Node Table
defects.what: Row 'Samsung 3GAE / SF3' conflates two nodes (module: 3GAE = SF3E, 2022; SF3 = 3GAP, 2024, ~170-190). Samsung SF2 density '~231 (claimed)' vs module '~200-230 est.'. Intel 14 nm and Intel 10/Intel 4 wafer prices ('~$4-5k est. (internal)', 'foundry-equiv. est. ~$8k', '~$16k') are invented; Module 21 lists them as 'internal', yet they are plotted as real points on the price axis.
defects.fix: Rename to 'Samsung 3GAE / SF3E' (optionally add the SF3/3GAP 2024 row), use the module's SF2 range (~215 midpoint), and either drop Intel-internal rows from the price axis (priceN: null -> skip point) or draw them hollow with an 'est.' marker.

defects.where: Calculator slider ranges (lines 140-142); node-table-760-dark-calc-min.png
defects.what: CPP slider goes down to 20 nm and MP to 15 nm, producing 1,111 MTr/mm² with no warning, although the module states CPP cannot go below ~45 nm (gate ~14 + 2x5 spacer + ~15 contact) and MP < 25 nm needs EUV double patterning. Extremes are unphysical rather than broken, but they teach the wrong thing.
defects.fix: Clamp CPP to 40-100 nm and MP to 20-70 nm; when CPP < 45 show a w-note 'below the physical CPP floor (gate + 2 spacers + contact)' and tint the readout with --warn.

defects.where: Readout row (lines 156-161) and detail placement (line 174); node-table-760-dark.png
defects.what: The headline result '145.2 MTr/mm²' is the 5th stat and wraps alone onto a second line at 760 px; hovering a table row gives feedback (detail text, enlarged dot) ~1,300 px below the row, so it is off-screen and invisible.
defects.fix: Put the MTr/mm² stat first and larger; place the detail line directly beneath the table (or at the top of the widget as a sticky strip) so row hover has visible feedback.

defects.where: Table markup (lines 46-57); node-table-360-dark.png
defects.what: At 360 px only Node / Foundry / HVM year / Transistor are visible; CPP, MP and density (the 'real yardsticks') require horizontal scrolling with no sticky column or scroll hint. Rows are 72 px tall because prose cells wrap 3-4 lines.
defects.fix: Make the first column position: sticky; left: 0 with background var(--panel); drop the Foundry column (use a colored chip before the node name instead); shorten headers to CPP / MP / FP / MTr/mm² / EUV / Lg / $/wafer and abbreviate prose cells (e.g. 'GAA + PowerVia'); or collapse the table by default.

defects.where: Line 53 (r._tr = tr) and line 107
defects.what: Instance DOM nodes are stored on the module-level ROWS constant; a second mount (module page + test page, or re-mount) overwrites _tr so the first instance highlights rows belonging to the second. Violates spec rule 9 in spirit (no shared mutable state).
defects.fix: Keep a local Map or array (rowEls) inside mount() and use it in setHover.

result.redesign: Lead with a drawing, not the table. Replace the current top-of-widget table with a to-scale NAND2 standard-cell schematic (SVG, viewBox sized from container width via ResizeObserver so labels stay >= 11 px; ~300 px tall at 760 px, ~260 px at 360 px). Scale: choose px/nm so the cell height (tracks x MP) fills ~80% of the SVG height (at N5 defaults 6 x 30 = 180 nm -> ~1.3 px/nm). Draw, all labelled in place with dimension arrows and mono numbers: (1) the cell boundary as a dashed rect with arrows 'width = 3 x CPP = 153 nm' along the top and 'height = 6 tracks x MP = 180 nm' along the right; (2) vertical gate stripes (--accent) at pitch CPP across the full cell height, each drawn at the node's gate length (Lg ~16 nm) with the arrow 'CPP 51 nm' between two gate centres and a small callout 'gate 16 + spacer 5 + contact 15 + spacer 5 = why CPP cannot go below ~45 nm'; (3) between gates, vertical source/drain contact bars (--cu) labelled 'S/D contact'; (4) horizontal M0 tracks (--cu, thin, semi-transparent) at pitch MP, numbered T1..T6 on the left, top and bottom tracks labelled 'VDD rail' / 'VSS rail', with the arrow 'MP 30 nm' between two adjacent tracks; (5) horizontal fins (--si) at fin pitch in the upper (PMOS) and lower (NMOS) halves labelled 'fin pitch 28 nm, fin ~6 nm wide' (for GAA rows draw a single wider bar per device labelled 'nanosheet stack'); (6) a tiny red (--bad) 3 nm tick beside the gate-length arrow labelled '3 nm: the node name. Nothing here is this small.'; (7) a readout strip inside the SVG bottom: 'area 153 x 180 nm² = 0.0275 µm² -> 4 transistors / area = 145 MTr/mm²'. The existing CPP / MP / tracks sliders drive this drawing live (gate stripes move, tracks re-space, the cell rect resizes), plus a 'Load node' select (TSMC N16, N7, N5, N3E, N2, Intel 7, 18A, Samsung 5LPE, SF3E) that sets CPP/MP/tracks/fin pitch/Lg from the table row and titles the drawing; default N5 (matches the current 51/30/6 defaults and the module's 145 MTr/mm² worked example). Optional animation: a 'Play node history' button that steps N16 -> N10 -> N7 -> N5 -> N3E -> N2 every 1.5 s so the reader watches CPP flatten at ~45 nm while cell height keeps shrinking; respect prefers-reduced-motion (start paused). Second block: keep the scatter plot but with persistent circles (no rebuild on hover), nice integer ticks, anchor-node labels, a dashed 'CPP floor ~45 nm' guide when CPP is on an axis, reference slopes '2x / node' and '1.15x / node' when density vs year is shown, and density vs wafer price as the default pair (shows cost per transistor stalling). Third block: the true-scale ruler shown by default, following the selected node (name nm, fin width, gate length, metal pitch, CPP, cell height). Last block: the full table collapsed behind 'Show full node table (16 rows)', sticky first column, foundry encoded as a color chip, abbreviated headers, and the detail line placed directly beneath it.

defects.where: site/widgets/damascene.js draw(): hole rects (s>=4, s>=5) start at viaTop=150 / trenchTop=74 while the low-k spans hmTop=50..192 and the hard mask sits at 34..50
defects.what: The via and trench are drawn as a BURIED cavity: from step 4 through step 10 an intact slab of low-k (y 50-74) and the intact purple hard mask remain sealed over the top of the trench. An etched feature must open from the wafer surface; a learner sees a floating T-shaped void inside the dielectric, which is impossible and contradicts the step text ('opens the trench pattern in the hard mask').
defects.fix: Draw the cavity as one path that starts at the TOP of the hard mask: step 4 = narrow via hole from hard-mask top down to (and stopping ON) the cap; step 5 = widen the upper part to the trench width (through hard mask + upper low-k) while the via continues below; the field hard mask stays only outside the trench.

defects.where: damascene-760-dark.png / -light.png / 360 renders (step 1, default first frame)
defects.what: First frame is ~370 px (of a 495 px SVG) of empty background: step 1 shows only a copper bar and a 4-unit cap that is invisible in dark theme. Criterion 2 (no large blank areas, first frame representative) fails.
defects.fix: Fill the first frame: draw the whole previous level (low-k with two M(n) copper lines at pitch, their barrier outlines, the SiCN cap on top) and a dotted outline of where the next trench/via will go; or start the step-through on step 7 or 9 and let step 1 be reachable via Prev.

defects.where: draw() s>=7 block: [via, tr].forEach(box => four-sided barrier + top/bottom liner)
defects.what: Barrier/liner are two CLOSED rectangles: a TaN band runs across the trench floor right over the via mouth (this would electrically block the via), a Co/Ru liner runs across the open top of the trench, no liner is drawn on any sidewall, and the via's bottom barrier sits at viaBot-4 leaving a 4-unit bare gap (white notch in light theme) above the M(n) copper it must contact.
defects.fix: Stroke ONE continuous open-top path that follows the cavity outline: field top -> trench sidewall -> trench floor (left of via) -> via sidewall -> via bottom (directly on the exposed Cu) -> via sidewall -> trench floor (right) -> trench sidewall -> field top. TaN (--warn, ~2.5 units) outside, Co/Ru (--bad, ~1.5 units) inside, on every surface, nothing across the via mouth or the trench opening.

defects.where: draw(): only one <text> ('M(n) copper - previous level') is placed in the drawing; everything else relies on the .w-legend row
defects.what: Legend-only labelling: cap, low-k, TEOS/TiN hard mask, barrier, liner, via, trench, overburden and the new line are never named in place. A non-expert cannot map the purple/yellow/red bands to parts (criterion 1).
defects.fix: Add in-place labels with leader lines in a right-hand margin (or halo text via paint-order:stroke): 'SiCN cap (etch stop) 10-25 nm', 'low-k SiOC:H k~2.5, 80-150 nm', 'TiN + TEOS hard mask', 'TaN barrier 1.5-2 nm', 'Co/Ru liner', 'via ~20 nm', 'trench 20 x 40 nm', 'overburden', 'M(n+1) line'. Font >= 12 viewBox units and verify >= 11 px at 360.

defects.where: draw(): hole height uses (s >= 6 ? viaBot - 4 : viaBot) - viaTop, so at steps 4-5 the hole covers the cap; cap rects are drawn split only from s>=6
defects.what: Steps 4-5 show the via already reaching the copper (cap removed) while the text says the etch 'stops on the SiCN cap ... leaving the cap intact'; step 6 ('Cap open') then changes only an invisible 4-unit band, so steps 5 and 6 look identical (zoomed crops confirm).
defects.fix: At steps 4-5 draw the cap band continuous across the via bottom (hole stops at viaBot-4) in a visible colour; at step 6 remove it under the via and add a small 'Cu exposed' callout so the state change is obvious.

defects.where: draw(): overburden rect drawn only when s === 10 at y = hmTop-30, above the intact hard mask
defects.what: The copper overburden appears only at the Anneal step and is separated from the trench copper by the intact hard mask and a slab of low-k, so it reads as a floating copper sheet added by annealing. Overburden is plated during ECD (step 9) and must be contiguous with the trench fill.
defects.fix: In the superfill animation, after the trench reaches the top, grow a blanket copper layer over the liner-coated field (on top of the hard mask) so at fill=1 it is continuous with the trench copper; keep it through step 10; label it 'overburden 200-800 nm'.

defects.where: draw() s === 11 branch: new cap at hmTop-20 while low-k top is hmTop; old cap only drawn for s <= 10; s>=7 barrier top edge still drawn
defects.what: Final state is wrong in four ways: the new SiCN cap floats 16 units above the surface with a gap of background; the copper is still buried under a low-k slab instead of flush with the surface; the barrier/liner 'lid' remains across the top of the copper after CMP; and the old cap between the low-k and M(n) disappears (it must remain forever).
defects.fix: At step 11 remove overburden, field barrier/liner and the hard mask, make the copper top flush with the low-k top, draw the new cap directly on that flush surface, and keep the old cap band under the low-k in every step.

defects.where: draw() s === 8 branch: two full-cavity rects at fill-opacity 0.35
defects.what: The PVD seed is drawn as a translucent solid fill of the entire trench and via, so it looks like a half-finished plate rather than a thin conformal film; the module's key points (overhang at the trench mouth, thin lower sidewalls, reflow puddle at the via bottom) are not shown.
defects.fix: Draw the seed as a thin (3-4 unit) copper film following the liner, thicker at the two trench-top corners (overhang), thinner on the lower via sidewalls, plus a small rounded copper puddle at the via bottom labelled 'reflow'.

defects.where: updatePhysics(): BARRIER=1.5, P=0.5, hLine=2w, rho = RHO0*(1+0.375*(1-P)*LAMBDA/w); readouts at w=20 -> 41.5 kOhm, 3.15 ns
defects.what: At the module's own worked example (20 nm M2) the widget reports 41.5 kOhm/mm and 3.15 ns versus the module's ~147 kOhm and ~11 ns (3.5x low), rho 2.32 vs 5-8 uOhm.cm. Causes: p=0.5 where the module says p~0 against TaN, no grain-boundary term, 1.5 nm TaN instead of 2 nm, and the bottom barrier not subtracted from height. The widget compensates with a three-line disclaimer instead of matching the course.
defects.fix: Use 2 nm TaN + 1.5 nm Co per side and on the bottom (h_eff = 2w - 3.5), p = 0, and add a grain-boundary term (Mayadas-Shatzkes with R~0.4, d~w) or a calibrated rho_eff = 1.68 + 2.7*39/w so that 20 nm gives ~7 uOhm.cm / ~147 kOhm / ~11 ns and 80 nm gives ~2.5 uOhm.cm / ~2.2 kOhm / ~0.17 ns; default the slider to 20 nm; delete the disclaimer paragraph.

defects.where: Cap rects use 'var(--line)'; legend chip for SiCN cap uses --line; low-k drawn with --si at 0.30 opacity but legend chip is solid --si
defects.what: The SiCN cap is invisible: --line (#253140) against the 30 % --si low-k in dark theme and near-white on white in light theme; its legend swatch is an invisible square in light theme. The low-k legend swatch (solid blue) does not match the pale grey-blue actually drawn.
defects.fix: Draw the cap with a contrasting token (e.g. --ink at 0.55 opacity or --muted, optionally hatched) and use the same colour in the legend; draw the low-k legend chip with the same 0.30-opacity --si used in the SVG.

defects.where: SVG viewBox 0 0 360 260 with font-size 11 / 10.5; at 360 px the SVG renders at 286 px (scale 0.79)
defects.what: All SVG text renders below 11 px on phones: measured bbox height 10 px for the 11 px label and the 10.5 px 'overburden' / 'new SiCN cap' labels render at ~8.3 px. The harness misses this because it reads CSS font-size, not rendered size.
defects.fix: Use font-size >= 14 viewBox units (or shrink the viewBox width to ~300 so scale at 360 px is ~0.95) and re-measure getBoundingClientRect().height >= 11 px at 360.

defects.where: draw() steps 9 (done) vs 10: identical cavity fill, only the misplaced overburden band differs
defects.what: The Anneal step draws nothing about what anneal does (fine as-plated grains recrystallising into large bamboo grains); the step-through drawing does not change meaningfully between steps 9 and 10.
defects.fix: At step 10 draw grain boundaries inside the copper: a fine hatch/many small polygons at step 9 end-state, 2-3 vertical bamboo grain-boundary lines spanning the line width at step 10, with a caption 'grains: tens of nm -> bamboo, R drops ~20 %'.

defects.where: nav dots: h('button', { class: 'w-step-dot', 'aria-label': ... })
defects.what: Hovering a dot shows no hover state and no tooltip (verified in hover-dot4 shot); the learner cannot preview which step a dot is.
defects.fix: Add title: STEPS[i].t to each dot (native tooltip) and, if the shared CSS lacks it, an inline hover style (border-color: var(--accent)).

defects.where: replayBtn placed as a direct child of the .w-steps grid; no Play/Pause
defects.what: Only a 'Replay fill animation' button exists (no Play/Pause as the spec asks), and because .w-steps is a one-column grid the button stretches to the full widget width, looking like a banner.
defects.fix: Make it a Play/Pause toggle that reflects state, wrap it in a flex row (or set justify-self:start) so it sits at natural width next to the step nav.

defects.where: STEPS[8].tool = 'Lam Sabre 3D'
defects.what: Module 12 states SABRE 3D is the packaging-plating variant; damascene plating uses SABRE Extreme/Max/Excel.
defects.fix: Change the tool line to 'Lam SABRE Extreme / Max (Applied Raider alt.)'.

defects.where: stats: fmt(R1mm/1000, 1) + ' kOhm'; fmt(wEff*hLine/1e6, 4) + ' um2'
defects.what: Precision collapses at the slider extremes: 100 nm shows 'R = 1 kOhm' (actual 0.97 kOhm) and 10 nm shows '0.0001 um2' (actual 80 nm2).
defects.fix: Show R in Ohm below 1 kOhm (or 2 significant digits), and show area in nm2 (e.g. '80 nm2', '1 440 nm2').

defects.where: STEPS[3].t = 'Via litho + etch (via-first)'
defects.what: The widget teaches via-first, which the module says was common through the 45 nm era; the module presents trench-first metal hard mask (TFMHM) as the current mainstream and explains self-aligned vias from it.
defects.fix: Either draw the TFMHM sequence (trench pattern etched into TiN first, then via litho/etch, then trench etch through the TiN opening) or add one sentence noting that modern flows are trench-first in the hard mask and why (self-aligned vias).

defects.where: Physics panel ('Line width vs. barrier tax and RC delay') has no drawing; main SVG shows a single lone T in a wide field with no dimensions
defects.what: The barrier-share story is told only in numbers; nothing shows the learner that 30-60 % of the width is TaN+Co, and the main drawing has no neighbouring lines or dimension callouts, so pitch and the w/h ratio never become visible.
defects.fix: Add a small cross-section bar next to the readouts (TaN | Co | Cu | Co | TaN, widths scaled to the slider, legend colours, with 'w' and 'h = 2w' dimension ticks); in the main SVG draw one neighbouring trench at pitch and add bracket callouts for cap, low-k thickness, trench w x h and via size.

defects.where: draw(): fill rects inset by 3 while barrier is 2 wide and no sidewall liner is drawn
defects.what: A 1-unit sliver of background shows between the copper and the barrier on both sidewalls of the trench and via at steps 9-11 (white lines in light theme), reading as voids.
defects.fix: Draw the liner on the sidewalls and inset the copper fill by exactly barrier + liner thickness so the layers touch.

result.redesign:
Keep the 11-step structure, the step texts (minus the tool-name fix) and the physics panel, but redraw the SVG as a real dual-damascene cross-section that is built from the wafer surface and stays physically consistent at every step.

LAYOUT (viewBox ~0 0 320 240 so it renders at ~0.95 scale on 360 px phones; drawing area x 10-230, right margin x 235-320 for labels with leader lines):
- Bottom band (y 190-235): the previous level M(n): low-k (--si at 0.30) containing TWO copper lines at pitch (one centred under the via at x~120, one neighbour at x~190), each outlined by a thin TaN/Co line; label in place 'M(n) Cu lines'.
- Old SiCN cap (y 182-190): a clearly visible band (--ink at ~0.5 opacity or --muted, optionally with a diagonal hatch), label 'SiCN cap (etch stop)'. This band stays in EVERY step; it is only opened under the via at step 6.
- Low-k ILD (y 60-182): --si at 0.30 with a sparse dot pattern to hint porosity; label 'low-k SiOC:H, k~2.5, 80-150 nm' with a bracket.
- Hard mask (y 46-60): two bands, TEOS oxide (--accent2 at 0.5) and TiN (--accent2 at 0.9), label 'TEOS + TiN hard mask'.
- Above y 46 is the wafer surface / process ambient (background). Nothing ever floats above the surface except the overburden and the new cap, which must sit ON the surface.

STEP GEOMETRY (cavity = one path, always open to the top):
1. Cap: full previous level + cap; also draw a dotted outline of the future trench+via so the frame is not empty.
2. Low-k: add the ILD block. 3. Hard masks: add both bands.
4. Via etch: a via hole (~24 wide) cut from the TOP of the hard mask down through the low-k, stopping ON the cap (cap band continuous across the via bottom); label 'via, ~20 nm, stops on cap'.
5. Trench etch: widen the top part (hard mask + upper ~45 % of low-k) to the trench width (~110); the via continues below; hard mask remains only outside the trench; label 'trench 20 x 40 nm'.
6. Cap open: remove the cap band under the via so M(n) copper is exposed; callout 'Cu exposed'.
7. Barrier + liner: one continuous open-top outline following field top -> trench walls -> trench floor -> via walls -> via bottom (directly on Cu): TaN (--warn, 2.5 units) then Co/Ru (--bad, 1.5 units) inside it, on every surface, with nothing across the trench opening or the via mouth; labels 'TaN barrier 1.5-2 nm', 'Co/Ru liner 1-2 nm'.
8. Cu seed: thin copper film (3-4 units) inside the liner, thicker at the two trench-top corners (overhang) and thinner low on the via walls, plus a small rounded copper puddle at the via bottom labelled 'reflow'.
9. ECD superfill (animated, Play/Pause + Replay): copper level rises as a flat piston in the via first, then in the trench, then a blanket overburden (~14 units) grows over the whole liner-coated field, contiguous with the trench copper; show 'bottom-up fill: NN %' and label 'overburden 200-800 nm'. Under reduced motion start at the finished state.
10. Anneal: same geometry; draw grain boundaries inside the copper: many small polygons -> 2-3 vertical bamboo boundaries spanning the line; caption 'fine grains -> bamboo grains, R -20 %'.
11. CMP + new cap: remove overburden, field barrier/liner and the hard mask; copper top flush with the low-k surface; draw the new cap directly on that flush surface; keep the old cap; labels 'M(n+1) line', 'via', 'new SiCN cap'.

LABELS/CONTRAST: every part labelled in place (right margin with leader lines, or halo text), font >= 12 viewBox units, verified >= 11 px at 360; cap and low-k colours must be distinct in both themes and the legend chips must use exactly the colours/opacities drawn.

PHYSICS PANEL: default slider 20 nm (module example), presets M2 20 nm / M8 80 nm; use 2 nm TaN + 1.5 nm Co per side and on the bottom, p = 0, plus a grain-boundary term (or calibrated rho_eff = 1.68 + 2.7*39/w) so 20 nm reproduces ~7 uOhm.cm, ~147 kOhm/mm, ~11 ns and 80 nm gives ~2.5 uOhm.cm, ~2.2 kOhm, ~0.17 ns; add a small width-split bar (TaN | Co | Cu | Co | TaN) scaled to the slider with w and h ticks; drop the disclaimer note.

Not a redraw: the wafer map (dies coloured good/bad, dashed edge-clipped dies, dashed exclusion ring, defect dots) and the yield-vs-area chart are recognisable and the physics is right. What the drawing lacks is in-place labelling and a stable defect field. Add to the map: a dimension line "300 mm" across the wafer, a "edge exclusion 3 mm" callout on the dashed ring, a notch at the bottom of the disc, one die called out with "29 x 28 mm", clip the edge-clipped dies to the wafer circle, and a stronger wafer outline in light theme. Add to the chart: a "yield" y-axis title, curve end-labels (Poisson / Murphy / NB alpha=2) beside the legend, and an x-range that covers the slider extremes with the marker labelled "812 mm2 -> 44%". Render both SVGs with a viewBox whose width equals the container pixel width (ResizeObserver) so 11-12 px labels stay 11-12 px at 360 px.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L59, L131, L135, L144 (chart SVG viewBox 640x260 scaled to 322 px at 360 wide)
defects.what: At 360 px the chart's axis labels, tick labels and axis title render at ~5.5 px (measured bounding-box height 6 px) and the map caption at ~8.9 px, far below the 11 px minimum; the chart is unreadable on a phone.
defects.fix: Size the chart (and map) viewBox to the container's pixel width via ResizeObserver so 1 SVG unit = 1 px and font-size 11-12 stays 11-12 px, or move the map caption and axis labels into HTML. Alternatively give the chart a narrower viewBox (e.g. 340 wide) below 480 px and re-draw on resize.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L131 and L135 (y tick '0%' at PL-8, x tick '10 mm2' centred at x=PL) and L135 '900 mm2' centred at x=W-PR
defects.what: The '0%' y-label and the '10 mm2' x-label collide at the chart's bottom-left corner (harness overlap report), and '900 mm2' is clipped at the SVG right edge (only '900 mm' visible).
defects.fix: Increase PB to ~40 and put the x tick labels at y = H-PB+18; anchor the first x tick 'start' and the last 'end' (or set PR to ~36); add an explicit 'yield' y-axis title.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L125-126, L143 (x range hard-coded 10..900 mm2 while sliders allow 3x3 = 9 mm2 to 35x35 = 1225 mm2)
defects.what: At slider extremes the current-die marker leaves the plot: at 3x3 mm it sits in the left gutter on top of the '100%' label; at 35x35 mm it disappears past the right edge (see die-min-3x3 and die-max-35x35 shots).
defects.fix: Extend the x range to cover the slider domain (e.g. 8..1300 mm2 with ticks 10/30/100/300/1000) or clamp the marker to the plot area and annotate it with the actual area; add a text label next to the marker ('812 mm2, 44.4 %').

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L34 (st.seed unused), L82-90 simulate(), L147-156 update() calls simulate() on every input event
defects.what: Every slider move re-rolls the random defect field, so the map flickers into a new random pattern whenever die size, edge or price changes; the core lesson ('same defects, smaller die -> more clean dies') cannot be seen, and the dedicated 'Re-roll defects' button is redundant.
defects.fix: Use a seeded PRNG (mulberry32 or similar) with st.seed; generate a fixed pool of defect positions from the seed and take the first Poisson(D0*area) of them so the pattern stays stable as D0 rises; only the Re-roll button increments the seed. Re-run simulate() only when D0, edge or seed change.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L82-93 simulate()/dieHasDefect and L176 mapNote
defects.what: The simulation always drops uniform (Poisson) defects and the note always compares to the Poisson prediction, even when Murphy or Negative binomial is selected: the readout says 50.6 % (NB, alpha=2) while the map and note still say 'vs. the Poisson prediction of 44.4 %', contradicting the model the user picked and never showing what clustering looks like.
defects.fix: When model = negbin, simulate clustered defects (e.g. Neyman-Scott: draw Poisson cluster centres, then a gamma/geometric number of defects within a few mm of each, tuned so the sampled per-die count is negative binomial with the chosen alpha) so the map visibly clusters and the simulated yield trends to the NB curve. At minimum compare the simulated yield to the selected model's prediction and state in the note that the simulation is uniform so clustered models predict more clean dies than the map shows.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L199-200 (h5 'Yield vs. die area, at this D0 and α' with textTransform: uppercase)
defects.what: CSS uppercase turns the Greek alpha into capital Alpha, so the heading reads 'YIELD VS. DIE AREA, AT THIS D0 AND A' at both widths, which looks like a typo and hides the parameter name.
defects.fix: Write 'alpha' in the heading, or wrap the alpha in a span with style text-transform:none, or drop text-transform on that heading.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L6 PRESETS H100 { w: 29, h: 28 } labelled '(814 mm2)'
defects.what: The H100 preset button says 814 mm2 but the readout shows 812 mm2, and the module gives the die as roughly 26 x 31 mm; the button label and the computed number disagree on the first frame.
defects.fix: Use w: 26, h: 31.3 (813.8 mm2, matches the module's '26 x 31 mm, close to the 26 x 33 mm reticle') or relabel the button to the value actually computed.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L38 sliders max 35 mm for width and height
defects.what: Sliders allow dies up to 35 x 35 mm, larger than the 26 x 33 mm reticle limit the module stresses, with no warning; the widget silently computes yields for an unprintable die.
defects.fix: Cap width/height at 33 mm (and mention the reticle limit in the caption or a note), or show a warning line 'exceeds the 26 x 33 mm reticle field' when w x h cannot fit in 26 x 33 in either orientation.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L172 stat(fmt(Y*100, 1) + ' %') and L174 cost per good die; L176 fmt(simYield*100, 1)
defects.what: At D0 = 1 the Poisson yield shows '0 %' (actual 0.03 %) and cost per good die shows '$879 036' with 'good dies 0'; at other settings the simulated yield prints '91%' next to '91.4%' (inconsistent precision).
defects.fix: Use adaptive precision for small yields (2 significant digits below 1 %), show cost per good die as '—' with a short note when expected good dies < 1, and format the simulated yield with the same fixed 1-decimal rule as the model yield.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L114-117 (clipped dies drawn as full rects) and L105 (wafer fill var(--ground))
defects.what: Edge-clipped dies are drawn as complete dashed rectangles that stick out beyond the wafer circle (silicon outside the wafer), and in light theme the wafer disc (#F3F5F8 on #FFFFFF) is almost invisible so the wafer silhouette barely reads; the legend swatch for edge-clipped uses solid --muted while the dies are drawn at 25 % opacity.
defects.fix: Wrap the die groups in a <clipPath> of the wafer circle; fill the wafer with var(--panel2) and stroke it with var(--line2) at 2 px so it reads in both themes; add a notch at the bottom; make the legend swatch use the same opacity/dashed style as the map.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L101-120 drawMap (no in-place labels) and L122-145 drawChart (legend-only curve naming, no y-axis title)
defects.what: The map has no in-place labels: nothing says '300 mm', 'edge exclusion 3 mm', 'scribe line' or the die size on the drawing itself (labelling is legend-only), and the chart has no y-axis title and no curve labels; a first-time viewer cannot tell what the dashed ring is without reading the legend.
defects.fix: Add a 300 mm dimension line, an 'edge exclusion 3 mm' callout on the dashed ring, one die annotated '29 x 28 mm', and a 'yield' y-axis title plus end-of-curve labels (Poisson / Murphy / NB alpha=2).

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L51 (Clustering alpha slider) and L41 (model select with no explanation)
defects.what: The Clustering alpha slider is enabled and changes nothing in the readout when Poisson or Murphy is selected, and no state has a one-line explanation of what Murphy / negative binomial / alpha mean (criterion 7: define a term the first time it appears).
defects.fix: Show a one-sentence explanation under the model select that changes with the selection (e.g. 'Negative binomial: defects cluster; alpha ~ 1-3 is typical, alpha -> infinity recovers Poisson') and dim or disable the alpha slider unless model = negbin (the chart's NB curve can still use it).

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L170-174 readout ('gross dies/wafer (formula)' 61 vs '(grid)' 65; 'cost per good die' $589)
defects.what: Two different gross-die numbers appear side by side with no hint why they differ, and 'cost per good die' ($589) is the un-harvested figure while the module's H100 worked example lands at $330-380 after harvesting; neither the label nor a note says harvesting is excluded.
defects.fix: Relabel to 'cost per perfect die (no harvesting)' and add one line explaining the DPW formula is an approximation while the grid is the actual count for this placement; optionally add an 'unrepairable area fraction' slider (default 30 %) that reports effective yield exp(-A_unrep*D0) and cost per sellable die, matching the module's ~78 % / $330-380.

defects.where: site/widgets/yield-calculator.js L91-93 dieHasDefect (linear scan of all defects per die)
defects.what: At 3 x 3 mm dies with D0 = 1 the update does ~6 900 dies x ~700 defects = ~5 M point-in-rect tests per slider tick, which will stutter while dragging.
defects.fix: Bin defects into the die grid once per simulate() (index by floor((x + offset)/pitch)) and look up the bin per die, or precompute a Set of hit dies from the defect list.

defects.where: site/widgets/transistor-evolution.js isoView() lines 66-121 (3D sketch, all four architectures)
defects.what: The 3D sketch does not show the defining geometry of any architecture. FinFET: the fin (box at line 98) is flush with the gate top and its ends are buried under S/D epi blocks of the same height (sdH=50), so it is only a faint ghost seen through the 0.72-opacity gate face; the 'fin (Si, ≈ 7 nm wide)' leader points at the edge of the spacer plate, not at a fin. Nanosheet/CFET: the sheets (line 101) run the full length inside the S/D epi boxes and are invisible except as faint stripes; the '3 sheets, 5 nm thick' leader points at the drain block. Planar, FinFET and GAA all read as green block / purple block / green block; a non-expert cannot tell them apart. The drawing also occupies only 149×127 px of the 335×251 px SVG (measured), with ~50 px empty above and ~70 px empty below.
defects.fix: Redraw as a cut-away isometric (see redesign): fin/sheets must be visible passing through a half-removed or translucent gate and emerging between spacer and S/D epi; S/D epi must sit on the channel ends, not enclose them; scale S from 0.8 to ~1.15 and re-centre so the drawing fills the frame.

defects.where: labelCol() line 62, footnotes lines 119 and 173, V_G meter text lines 133-135 — font-size 11 in a 360-unit viewBox rendered in a 335 px column (760 px) and a 286 px column (360 px)
defects.what: Every SVG label renders at 10.2 px on desktop and 8.7 px at 360 px (measured: svg width 335 → 11×335/360; 286 → 11×286/360). Both are below the 11 px floor; the harness misses it because it checks the unscaled font-size.
defects.fix: Raise SVG text to ≥ 14 viewBox units (→ 13 px at 760, 11.1 px at 360) and shorten/wrap labels accordingly, or reduce the viewBox width to ~300 with a narrower label column; verify with rendered px = font-size × svgClientWidth / viewBoxWidth.

defects.where: xsView() lines 141-143, 147-154, 163-164; legend line 207; applyV() line 179
defects.what: The inversion layer (var(--warn)) and the gate oxide/high-k (var(--accent)) are near-identical ambers in both themes (#F2B13B vs #F0B429 dark; #B8770A vs #C98A00 light). The inversion layer is a 2.2 px line drawn just inside a 3 px high-k outline of the same colour, so when the animation fades it the drawing looks unchanged — only the V_G bar and ON/OFF text move (compare finfet-play-1.6s-off vs 3.2s-on shots). The legend shows two indistinguishable swatches for 'gate oxide / high-k' and 'inversion layer · spacers'. The caption promises 'shows where the inversion layer forms' and the drawing does not deliver it.
defects.fix: Draw the inversion layer as a filled band in var(--ink) (bright in dark theme, near-black in light) 3-4 px thick with animated opacity, plus 4-6 animated carrier dots along the channel in the 3D sketch when ON; move spacers to var(--line2) with a hatch so --warn is freed; keep high-k as a thin var(--accent) stroke.

defects.where: xsView() CFET branch lines 156-170 and applyV() line 179 (anim.inv applied uniformly)
defects.what: For CFET all four sheets (two nFET and two pFET) show inversion together at V_G = 0.70 V and all go dark at 0 V. In a complementary pair sharing one gate the pFET is ON when the gate is low and OFF when it is high; showing both tiers switching in phase teaches the wrong thing about the one architecture whose whole point is complementarity.
defects.fix: For CFET apply opacity v to the nFET sheets and (1 − v) to the pFET sheets; change the state text to 'nFET ON · pFET OFF' / 'nFET OFF · pFET ON'; tint or label the two tiers distinctly.

defects.where: xsView() lines 145-146, 158, 160; isoView() lines 91-92, 102; legend line 207 — light theme
defects.what: In light theme the substrate (var(--si) at 0.35-0.45 opacity ≈ #C5D0DC), the STI oxide (var(--line2) #C3CBD6), the bottom isolation and the middle isolation (all --line2) are indistinguishable pale greys, so three different materials merge into one slab and the 'STI / isolation' legend swatch is nearly invisible on the white panel (see 760-light-gaa-w30 and 360-light shots).
defects.fix: Give the substrate a solid var(--si) fill at ≥ 0.6 opacity with a var(--muted) outline; stroke STI and isolation rects with 1 px var(--muted) and add a diagonal hatch pattern for the isolation layers; give legend swatches a 1 px var(--line) border.

defects.where: isoView() lines 80, 83, 93; xsView() line 137; controls line 203 (checkbox available for every architecture)
defects.what: Backside power rail is drawn as a copper bar floating ~6 px under a thick substrate with no connection in the cross-section; in the 3D sketch the nano-TSV is hidden inside the S/D block (GAA/CFET) or appears to float in front of the substrate (FinFET, painter's order). A non-expert cannot see what the rail does. The checkbox is also offered on Planar, an anachronism (planar ended ~2011; PowerVia/SPR arrive 2025-26).
defects.fix: When the rail is on, thin the substrate to a sliver (as PowerVia does), put the rail directly under the STI, and draw a visible nano-TSV pillar from the rail up through the STI to the bottom of the source epi in both views (or annotate 'TSV out of plane' in the cross-section); disable the checkbox for Planar with a note 'backside power arrived with 18A / A16'.

defects.where: isoView() line 102 and 113 (sd(..., CU) for pFET S/D); legend line 207

with Bonding method (or a leading muted Bonding:), expand the labels to 'TC-NCF (Samsung)' / 'MR-MUF (SK hynix)', and drop the empty elements from selects and radios.

defects.what: The 'over' state is barely perceptible in the drawing: the stack top sits ~5 px above the dashed ceiling line and only the tiny '760 um' label turns red.
